intro: We currently hold only {{count}} MBA / PGDM college in Kerala that meets this page's ₹{{threshold}} lakh highest-package test: IIM Kozhikode. It is the sole entry among MBA colleges in Kerala with ₹50 lakh highest package in our file.

IIM Kozhikode is 3rd in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking and leads the top MBA colleges in Kerala 2026. The card that now clears this threshold is the official 2025 flagship PGP: a highest CTC of ₹81 LPA and a mean of ₹28.18 LPA.
listLead: The card uses the official 2025 flagship PGP report, not an older executive programme row. Still confirm fees and the current admission cycle on the official site.
